description: Complete rewrite of index.html and css/styles.css to match the reference site sadarnimantran.in/invite/arjun-meera. This produces the full visual layout with all 10 sections, exact color palette, 5 Google Fonts, jhalar scalloped edges, inline SVG decorations (mandalas, corner ornaments, heart dividers, diya lamps), real images from assets/images/, RSVP form markup, and CSS animations/transitions (reveal, entrance, parallax, countdown tick). The page should look complete and beautiful when opened statically — JS adds interactivity in FEAT-002.
steps: Step 1 — Set up index.html skeleton. DOCTYPE html, lang='en', charset UTF-8, viewport meta (width=device-width, initial-scale=1). Title: 'Arjun weds Meera — Wedding Invitation'. Preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com. Google Fonts link loading ALL FIVE fonts: Great Vibes, Cormorant Garamond (wght 300..700, ital), Anek Devanagari (wght 400..700), Anek Latin (wght 400..500), Kalam (wght 300;400). Link to css/styles.css. Script tag for js/script.js with defer. Body contains: #loader overlay div, fixed .music-toggle button (3 span bars), and <main> wrapping all 10 sections.

Step 2 — Set up css/styles.css with CSS custom properties on :root. EXACT palette: --i-bg:#f7f5ef; --i-bg2:#f9faf7; --i-card:#fbf8f2; --i-ink:#2b0f14; --i-ink-soft:#3d2420; --i-gold:#a98238; --i-gold-dark:#8a6a2c; --i-accent:#6e0f1c; --i-stage:#1a1510; --i-on-stage:#fff; --i-line:rgba(169,130,56,0.34). Font stacks: --f-script:'Great Vibes',cursive; --f-serif:'Cormorant Garamond',Garamond,serif; --f-hindi:'Anek Devanagari',sans-serif; --f-body:'Anek Latin','Anek Devanagari',sans-serif; --f-hand:'Kalam',cursive. Gold foil gradient variable: --gold-foil:linear-gradient(to bottom right,#8a6a2c,#d9b866,#a98238,#f3e2a8,#9a7633). Transition: --ease-reveal:0.7s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1). Global reset (box-sizing border-box, margin/padding 0). html: scroll-behavior smooth. body: font-family var(--f-body), color var(--i-ink), background var(--i-bg), font-size clamp(15px,2.2vw,17px), line-height 1.65, overflow-x hidden, -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased. Container queries: main { container-type: inline-size; container-name: page; }.

Step 3 — CSS: Reveal animation system. Define .reveal class: opacity 0, transform translateY(var(--reveal-y,24px)), transition opacity var(--ease-reveal), transform var(--ease-reveal); transition-delay var(--reveal-offset,0s). .reveal.is-visible: opacity 1, transform translateY(0). This uses custom properties --reveal-y and --reveal-offset for per-element control of distance and stagger delay.

Step 4 — CSS: Loader overlay. #loader: position fixed, inset 0, z-index 9999, background var(--i-bg), display grid, place-items center, transition opacity 0.6s ease-out. #loader.is-hidden: opacity 0, pointer-events none. Inside loader, create a CSS-only animated ornament — a gold circle that pulses using @keyframes loader-pulse (scale 0.8 to 1.2, opacity 0.4 to 1, repeating). Style it as a 40px circle with border 2px solid var(--i-gold).

Step 5 — CSS: Music toggle button. .music-toggle: position fixed, bottom 1.5rem, right 1.5rem, z-index 100, width 44px, height 44px, border-radius 50%, background var(--i-gold), border none, cursor pointer, display flex, align-items center, justify-content center, gap 2.5px, box-shadow 0 2px 10px rgba(169,130,56,0.35). Three inner spans: width 2.5px, background var(--i-on-stage), border-radius 1px. Animate with @keyframes music-bar (height oscillates 4px to 16px). .music-toggle span:nth-child(1) height 10px, delay 0s; :nth-child(2) height 14px, delay 0.15s; :nth-child(3) height 8px, delay 0.3s. .music-toggle.is-paused span: animation none, height 3px.

Step 6 — CSS: Jhalar scalloped edge divider. This is CRITICAL and appears between every section color transition. Create .jhalar class: display block, width 100%, height 22px, position relative. The scallop effect uses background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0, var(--jhalar-color,var(--i-bg)) 8px, transparent 8.5px) repeat-x; background-size: 22px 22px; background-position: center top. Also create .jhalar--flip for bottom-facing scallops (circle at 50% 100%). Create color variants: .jhalar--stage uses --jhalar-color:var(--i-stage); .jhalar--bg uses --jhalar-color:var(--i-bg); .jhalar--bg2 uses --jhalar-color:var(--i-bg2). Place a .jhalar div between EVERY section transition in the HTML where the background color changes.

Step 7 — HTML+CSS: Section 1 — HERO (#top). Full-screen section (height: 100svh on supporting browsers, fallback 100vh). Structure:
. BACKGROUND LAYER:
containing — CSS: position absolute, inset 0, object-fit cover, filter blur(18px) saturate(0.7), transform scale(1.15) to avoid blur edge gaps. FOREGROUND:
with — centered, max-height 65vh, with a subtle radial gradient overlay glow behind it (pseudo-element with radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,220,160,0.25), transparent 70%)). OVERLAY CONTENT positioned on top with z-index:
. Inside: (a) Top group with 'Shubh Vivah' in Cormorant Garamond uppercase, letter-spacing 0.25em, flanked by two thin horizontal hairlines (1px gold lines via elements). (b) Names: 'Arjun' and 'Meera' each in Great Vibes, font-size 16.5cqw (container query width units), with 'weds' between them in Cormorant Garamond italic smaller. (c) Inline SVG heart divider with gold foil gradient fill. (d) 'Udaipur, Rajasthan' Cormorant Garamond uppercase, letter-spacing 0.2em. (e) Bottom area: 'You and your family are cordially invited' text. (f) Two circular ripple SVG seal badges (simple circles with 'A' and 'M' text, animated subtle pulsing ring). Add staggered entrance reveal delays: top group --reveal-offset:0.35s, names 0.6s, heart 1.35s, place 1.5s, invite 2.45s, seals 2.7s. CSS: Dark stage background (--i-stage) on the section itself. Text color --i-on-stage (white). The entire section uses the dark warm tone.

Step 8 — HTML+CSS: Section 2 — CARD / Couple Intro (#card). Place a .jhalar.jhalar--stage div BEFORE this section to create the scalloped transition from hero dark to cream. Section: <section id='card' class='i-card'>. Background: var(--i-bg). Structure: (a) Large decorative mandala SVGs positioned absolute left and right (desktop only via @media min-width:1024px, opacity 0.08, gold stroke, no fill, ~300px wide). Create simple inline SVG mandalas with concentric circles and radial lines. (b) Central card container: max-width 640px, margin auto, background var(--i-card), border-radius 16px, padding 3rem 2rem, box-shadow 0 4px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.06). (c) Four corner ornament SVGs inside the card (position absolute at each corner — top-left, top-right rotated 90deg, bottom-right 180deg, bottom-left 270deg). Simple floral/leaf motif inline SVG, gold color, ~40px. (d) Inside card: ganesh.webp centered, width ~5rem. (e) '॥ श्री गणेशाय नमः ॥' in Anek Devanagari, color var(--i-gold). (f) Sanskrit mantra in Cormorant Garamond italic, color var(--i-ink-soft). (g) 'With the blessings of our elders and the love of our families'. (h) Couple details in two-column layout (flex on mobile stack, row on tablet+): LEFT column — 'Chi.' label small uppercase Cormorant, 'Arjun' in Great Vibes large, 'Grandson of Late Shri Om Prakash & Smt. Kamla Khanna', 'Son of Smt. Ritu & Shri Rajeev Khanna', 'Greater Kailash II, New Delhi'. CENTER — 'weds' in Cormorant Garamond italic with small decorative SVG flourishes above and below. RIGHT column — 'Sau. Kan.' label, 'Meera' in Great Vibes, 'Granddaughter of Smt. Shakuntala & Shri Har Prasad Saxena', 'Daughter of Smt. Anjali & Shri Alok Saxena', 'Gomti Nagar, Lucknow'. (i) Gold SVG divider line with heart center. (j) Elder blessings section: 'With the blessings of' heading, 'Late Shri Om Prakash Khanna' and 'Smt. Kamla Khanna' names.

Step 9 — HTML+CSS: Section 3 — OUR STORY (#our-story). Section:
. Background var(--i-bg). Heading 'Our Story' in Cormorant Garamond. Gold SVG heart divider below heading. Timeline:
with vertical gold line (2px) via ::before pseudo-element (left-aligned on mobile, centered on desktop >=768px). Five timeline items, each as
: (a)
— 12px gold circle on the line. (b)
containing: in Cormorant Garamond uppercase gold,

milestone title in Cormorant Garamond,

description in Kalam font (--f-hand). Milestones with EXACT text: (1) September 2019 / 'First Met' / 'A mutual friend's Diwali party in Delhi. Arjun spilled chai, Meera laughed.' (2) December 2019 / 'First Date' / 'A long walk through Lodhi Garden, talking until the guards shooed them out.' (3) March 2021 / 'The Trip' / 'Backpacking through Himachal. Somewhere near Kasol, they knew.' (4) November 2025 / 'The Proposal' / 'Under the stars at Fateh Sagar Lake, Udaipur. She said yes before he finished asking.' (5) February 2027 / 'The Wedding' / 'And now, the beginning of forever.' Desktop >=768px: items alternate left/right using nth-child(odd/even), text-align switches, dot repositions to center line. Stagger each item with incremental --reveal-offset.

Step 10 — HTML+CSS: Section 4 — SAVE THE DATE + COUNTDOWN (#countdown). Section:
. Background var(--i-bg2). Heading area: 'Save the date' small label Cormorant uppercase, then 'Friday, 19 February 2027' as the main date. 'Scratch the three hearts to reveal our day' instruction text. THREE SCRATCH HEARTS:
containing 3
wrappers. Each wrapper has: an inline SVG heart shape (the visible decorative border/outline), a element overlaid (positioned absolute, same dimensions, clipped to heart shape via CSS clip-path using the heart SVG path data), and hidden text underneath ('Friday,' / '19 February' / '2027'). The canvas is where JS draws the gold scratch layer. CSS clip-path for heart shape: clip-path: path('M100,180 C65,160 0,120 0,70 C0,20 35,0 65,10 C80,15 95,35 100,50 C105,35 120,15 135,10 C165,0 200,20 200,70 C200,120 135,160 100,180Z') scaled appropriately. Style hearts with gold foil gradient border. REVEALED DATE:
(initially opacity 0): 'Friday, 19 February 2027' large Cormorant and 'Phere at the muhurat of 11:40 pm' Cormorant italic gold. COUNTDOWN:
with 4 boxes: each
containing 00 and days/hours/minutes/seconds. Box styling: background var(--i-card), border 1px solid var(--i-line), border-radius 10px, padding. Number: Cormorant Garamond, color var(--i-accent). Label: small uppercase, color var(--i-gold). @keyframes cd-tick for subtle scale pulse on change.

Step 11 — HTML+CSS: Section 5 — EVENTS (#events). Section: <section id='events' class='i-events'>. Background var(--i-bg). Heading area: '18 to 19 February' subtitle Cormorant uppercase gold, 'The functions' main heading Cormorant. Gold SVG heart divider. THREE EVENT CARDS in a grid (1 column mobile, 3 columns at >=900px): each <article class='i-event reveal'> has: (a) Watercolor art background image (haldi-800.webp / mehndi-800.webp / baraat-800.webp) as background-image, background-size cover, with a semi-transparent cream overlay (::before pseudo with background rgba(247,245,239,0.82)) so text is readable. (b) Event name LARGE overlay text (Cormorant Garamond, uppercase, letter-spacing) — 'Haldi' / 'Mehndi & Sangeet' / 'Baraat & Shubh Vivah'. (c) Date and time. (d) Gold heart divider small. (e) Venue name. (f) Description text. (g) Dress code as a gold pill/badge: background var(--i-gold)/10%, border-radius 20px, padding. 'Dress' label + value: 'Shades of yellow' / 'Pastels, pinks and greens' / 'Your festive best'. (h) 'Directions' button — rounded, background var(--i-accent), color white, padding 0.5rem 1.5rem. Links to Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Phool+Mahal+Bagh+Udaipur. Card styling: border-radius 16px, overflow hidden, min-height 420px (mobile), aspect-ratio on desktop. EXACT EVENT TEXT: Haldi — Thu 18 Feb 2027, 10:30 am, The Lake Lawns Phool Mahal Bagh, 'Marigolds, a dholki and a great deal of turmeric. Wear something you will not miss.' Mehndi & Sangeet — Thu 18 Feb 2027, 5:30 pm, The Rose Courtyard Phool Mahal Bagh, 'Henna for the hands, songs for the heart, and both families on one dance floor.' Baraat — has extra subtitle 'Friday · 19 February' and 'The main celebration', Fri 19 Feb 2027, 6:30 pm, Phool Mahal Bagh Fateh Sagar Road, 'The baraat sets off at 6:30, jaimala at 8, and phere under the stars at 11:40.'

Step 12 — HTML+CSS: Section 6 — THE FAMILIES (#family). Place .jhalar.jhalar--bg div before section. Section: <section id='family' class='i-family'>. Background var(--i-bg2). Heading: 'The families' small label, 'Two families, one celebration' main heading Cormorant. TWO FAMILY CARDS in flex row (stacked on mobile): each <div class='i-family__card reveal'> with: label 'The groom's family' / 'The bride's family' small Cormorant uppercase, family name 'The Khannas' / 'The Saxenas' in Cormorant Garamond semi-bold, parent names, city. Card styling: background var(--i-card), border 1px solid var(--i-line), border-radius 12px, padding 2rem. HANDWRITTEN QUOTE: <div class='i-family__note'> styled as a tilted card (transform rotate(-1deg)), background var(--i-card), border-left 3px solid var(--i-gold), padding, using Kalam font, with a warm family quote. FAMILY MEMBER LISTS: <div class='i-family__roles'>: (a) 'Darshanabhilashi' heading (Cormorant italic gold), names: 'Rajeev Khanna', 'Sanjeev Khanna', 'Rakesh Khanna'. (b) 'Swagatotsuk' heading, names: 'Kabir, Tanya, Ishaan, Riya' and 'and the whole Khanna family'. CLOSING: 'Delhi and Lucknow, one family from now on.' Cormorant italic.

Step 13 — HTML+CSS: Section 7 — GALLERY (#gallery). Section: <section id='gallery' class='i-gallery'>. Background var(--i-bg). Heading: 'Moments' small label, 'A few moments so far' main heading, gold heart divider. FOUR PLACEHOLDER CARDS in 2x2 grid (mobile) / 4-col (desktop): each <figure class='i-gallery__item reveal'> with <div class='i-gallery__placeholder'> and <figcaption>. Placeholders are intentionally elegant — NOT broken images. Style each with a distinct soft gradient background from the palette: card 1 linear-gradient(135deg, #f0ebe0, rgba(169,130,56,0.12)), card 2 linear-gradient(135deg, #f5f0e8, rgba(110,15,28,0.08)), card 3 linear-gradient(135deg, #eee9de, rgba(169,130,56,0.15)), card 4 linear-gradient(135deg, #f2ede4, rgba(138,106,44,0.10)). Each has a subtle decorative element — a thin gold border, and a small SVG ornament (simple leaf or floral) centered at ~30% opacity. Aspect-ratio 3/4. Border-radius 12px. Figcaptions: 'Under the rose arch', 'Haldi morning', 'Mehndi and sangeet', 'The baraat arrives' — italic Cormorant. Hover: slight scale(1.03) and shadow lift.

Step 14 — HTML+CSS: Section 8 — VENUE (#venue). Place .jhalar.jhalar--bg div before section. Section: <section id='venue' class='i-venue'>. Background var(--i-bg2). Heading: 'The venue' label, 'Getting here' main heading. MAP CARD: <div class='i-venue__map'> — a styled placeholder for the map. Background: a subtle gradient or pattern suggesting a map, with venue name 'Phool Mahal Bagh' large Cormorant, 'Fateh Sagar Road, Udaipur' subtitle, and an 'Open in Google Maps' button (background var(--i-accent), color white, rounded) linking to https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Phool+Mahal+Bagh+Udaipur. TRAVEL INFO: 4 cards in 2x2 grid, each <div class='i-venue__info reveal'> with: a simple inline SVG icon (plane, train, bed, thermometer — clean line-art style, gold stroke), heading, and description. (1) 'By air' / 'Maharana Pratap Airport is about 40 minutes from the venue.' (2) 'By train' / 'Udaipur City station is 20 minutes away. Tell us your train and we'll send a car.' (3) 'Where to stay' / 'Rooms are held at the venue for family and friends. Mention it in your reply.' (4) 'February nights' / 'The days are mild, but by the lake the nights drop to about 10°C. Carry a shawl for the phere.' Card styling: background var(--i-card), border-radius 12px, padding 1.5rem, flex with icon.

Step 15 — HTML+CSS: Section 9 — RSVP (#rsvp). Place .jhalar.jhalar--bg2 div before section. Section: <section id='rsvp' class='i-rsvp'>. Background var(--i-bg). Heading: 'Will you come?' Cormorant Garamond. Deadline: 'Please reply by' + 'Sunday, 31 January' (bold/accent). Plate text: 'So a room, a seat and a plate of malai ghewar are kept ready for you.' RSVP FORM CARD: <div class='i-rsvp__card'> — background var(--i-card), border-radius 16px, padding 2.5rem, box-shadow, position relative. STAMP BADGE: <div class='i-rsvp__stamp'> positioned absolute top-right, rotated ~-12deg, width 56px, height 56px, border-radius 50%, background var(--i-accent), color white, display grid place-items center, font-family Cormorant, 'A&M' text. FORM: <form id='rsvp-form' class='i-rsvp__form'>. (a) Name input: <label>Your name</label> <input type='text' name='name' required placeholder='Full name'>. (b) Attendance radios: <fieldset> with <legend>Will you attend?</legend>, two radio options: <label><input type='radio' name='attending' value='yes' checked> Yes, we'll be there</label> and <label><input type='radio' name='attending' value='no'> Sorry, can't make it</label>. Style radios with custom CSS (hidden native, custom gold circle indicator). (c) Message textarea: <label>A note for the family (optional)</label> <textarea name='message' rows='3' placeholder='Write something lovely...'></textarea>. (d) Submit button: <button type='submit' class='i-rsvp__submit'>Send reply on WhatsApp</button> — background var(--i-accent), color white, border-radius 30px, padding 0.8rem 2rem, width 100%. (e) Small note below form: 'Your reply opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message' in small text. Input styling: background transparent, border-bottom 1px solid var(--i-line), padding 0.6rem 0, font-family var(--f-body), font-size 1rem, color var(--i-ink). Focus: border-color var(--i-gold). Textarea: same but with full border, border-radius 8px, resize vertical.

Step 16 — HTML+CSS: Section 10 — CLOSING (#closing). Place .jhalar.jhalar--bg div before section (scalloping cream into dark). Section: <section id='closing' class='i-closing'>. Background var(--i-stage). Color var(--i-on-stage). DIYA/LAMP SVGs: Two inline SVG diya (oil lamp) illustrations positioned left and right of the text. Simple elegant line-art style: a small bowl shape with a flame. The flame has a CSS animation @keyframes flame-flicker — subtle scale/opacity oscillation (transform: scaleY(0.9) to scaleY(1.1), opacity 0.8 to 1, duration ~1.5s, ease-in-out, infinite alternate). CONTENT: Gold heart divider SVG. Main text: 'Your presence is the only gift we ask for.' in Cormorant Garamond, large, color var(--i-on-stage). Credit: 'The Khanna & Saxena families' in smaller Cormorant. Small 'Invitation by' credit at very bottom, muted. Another gold heart divider at bottom.

Step 17 — CSS: Responsive breakpoints and container queries. MOBILE FIRST base (320-480px): single column everything, font-size clamp values, padding comfortable for thumbs. @container page (min-width: 480px): scratch hearts in a row not wrapping, countdown boxes wider. @container page (min-width: 768px) OR @media (min-width: 768px): couple details side-by-side in card section, timeline alternates left/right, family cards in a row, venue grid 2x2, gallery 2x2 stays, event cards still single column. @media (min-width: 900px): event cards become 3-column grid. @media (min-width: 1024px): show mandala SVGs on card section, increase max-widths, gallery 4-column, larger font scaling, more generous padding. Ensure hero uses 100svh with 100vh fallback. Container query unit cqw used for hero couple names (16.5cqw). All fluid typography uses clamp().

Step 18 — CSS: Gold foil gradient application. Apply the gold foil gradient (var(--gold-foil)) to all decorative gold elements using background-clip: text / -webkit-background-clip: text / color: transparent technique for: heart SVG fills (use the gradient in SVG defs as linearGradient), divider lines, and any gold text that should shimmer. For SVG hearts, define a <defs><linearGradient id='gold-foil' ...> in the first SVG and reference it via url(#gold-foil) in subsequent SVG fill attributes. Alternatively, apply the gradient as a CSS background on wrapper elements with -webkit-background-clip: text.
acceptance_criteria: index.html contains all 10 sections in the correct DOM order with all text content matching the reference site exactly.
css/styles.css uses the exact --i-* color palette and all 5 font families.
Jhalar scalloped edges appear between every section color transition (hero→card, before family, before venue, before rsvp, before closing at minimum).
Hero section is full-screen with couple-640.webp blurred background, couple.webp foreground centered, and overlay text with correct fonts.
Card section has ganesh.webp, couple details in two columns, corner ornament SVGs, and elder blessings.
Events section has watercolor art backgrounds (haldi/mehndi/baraat-800.webp) on cards with readable overlaid text.
RSVP section has a complete form with name input, yes/no radios, message textarea, and submit button.
Closing section has dark background with diya lamp SVGs and animated flames.
Gallery placeholders look intentionally elegant (gradient backgrounds, gold borders) not broken.
Page is mobile-first: readable and well-spaced at 375px width, multi-column layouts at 768px+.
All .reveal elements have CSS transitions defined for JS to trigger by adding .is-visible.
No external image dependencies for decorative elements — all ornaments are inline SVG or CSS.
No console errors when opened in browser.
Our Story section uses Kalam font for milestone descriptions.

Verify all 7 images load (couple-640, couple, ganesh, haldi-800, mehndi-800, baraat-800 in HTML, cover-poster if used).
Verify jhalar scalloped edges are visible between section transitions.
Check browser console for errors — there should be none.
